provenance.citation: WBC ΔΣ predecessor: Backbone.js/JSP Manual Differential Counter, 2015, retained at legacy/ and described in DCR-004. Configuration recovered from web/settings/templates.json at commit aa88da4 and verified by executing the application under Playwright (DCR-032).
provenance.notes: This profile exists so an operator familiar with the predecessor tool can switch without relearning the keyboard. Its nine categories are COARSER than ICSH 2008 §2.6: 'gran' aggregates myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils into one key; 'pro' covers promyelocytes and myelocytes together; 'baso' covers basophils and mast cells. A count taken in this profile therefore cannot be reported against the ICSH nucleated differential count without re-counting. Prefer ndc-14 for new work.

description: The 2015 predecessor counter's layout, key-for-key: A S D F Z X C V B, with its Yale SOM, Precipio DX and MGH report templates. Categories are aggregated as that tool aggregated them. Percentages use this application's rounding rather than the predecessor's — see provenance.

categoryNotes.gran: Maturing granulocyte forms as one category — myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils together. The predecessor tool counted them on one key and this profile preserves that. ICSH 2008 §2.6 asks for them separately; use ndc-14 if the separation matters.
categoryNotes.pro: Promyelocytes AND myelocytes, as the predecessor's report wording states.
categoryNotes.baso: Basophils and mast cells together, as the predecessor's report wording states. ICSH lists mast cells separately.

ME_ratio.label: M:E Ratio
ME_ratio.basis: ICSH 2008 §2.6: all granulocytes and monocytes and their precursors over erythroblasts at all stages; lymphocytes and plasma cells take no part. The predecessor's Precipio DX template reserved a field for this ratio and printed a literal underscore — it was never computed. It is computed here (DCR-032).

specimenTypes.targetCountBasis: The predecessor tool's own minimum for bone marrow was 200 cells and this profile preserves it. ICSH 2008 §2.6 asks for at least 500 when a precise percentage of an abnormal cell type is required for diagnosis, and at least 300 when the differential is not essential to it — so a 200-cell marrow count will raise the sub-target advisory, which is correct.

categoryNotes.pro: Immature granulocytic precursors as one category, as the predecessor's report wording states.
categoryNotes.other: The predecessor offered no category for nucleated red cells in peripheral blood. If NRBC are seen, this profile cannot report them per 100 WBC — use ndc-14, which excludes them from the denominator and reports them by the ICSH convention (DCR-006).

templates.outSentence: A {{total}}-cell differential count of peripheral blood reveals: {{poly}}% mature neutrophils, {{bands}}% band forms, {{lymph}}% lymphocytes, {{mono}}% monocytes, {{eos}}% eosinophils, {{baso}}% basophils, {{pro}}% immature granulocytic precursors, {{blasts}}% blasts, and {{other}}% others.

specimenTypes.targetCountBasis: The predecessor tool's own minimum for peripheral blood was 100 cells and this profile preserves it. CLSI H20-A2's reference method is two reviewers counting 200 cells each; 100 is half one observer's share, so the sub-target advisory will fire and state the imprecision.
